title: The Frostglass Reliquary
theme: Frozen ruin and arctic cave with cracked ice, buried stonework, and wind-scoured relic halls
hook: A pale blue light has begun pulsing beneath the glacier after every moonrise. Hunters say the old reliquary bells now ring under the ice, even though the ruin has been buried for centuries.
background: The reliquary was built around a sainted winter flame that was meant to preserve memory through disaster. The glacier swallowed the site, cracked its wards, and trapped oathbound spirits, ice-fed beasts, and a living frostglass relic beneath unstable frozen floors.

connections.note: Hidden under-ice crawl beneath wind-packed snow

playerSafe.description: A frozen reliquary ruin with visible snow paths, ice bridges, buried stone chambers, and dark cracks beneath the ice.

layout.notes: Frozen ruin/arctic cave with cracked pools, ice bridges, slick ledges, snow-buried stonework, and hazardous under-ice routes.

rooms.name: Snow-Choked Entry Cleft
rooms.readAloud: Wind claws through a split in the glacier. Snow has drifted into stair-like shelves, and old stone blocks show beneath the blue ice.
rooms.gmNotes: The entry is exposed and loud. Careful listening reveals bell tones under the ice whenever someone steps near the buried crawl.

inhabitants.name: Frostbitten Snow Hares
inhabitants.tactics: Scatter through snow shelves, reveal hidden hollows, panic at loud noise
inhabitants.morale: Flee from fire or sudden movement
inhabitants.leverage: Can be lured toward hidden weak ice with dried fruit or grain

rooms.treasure: A cracked brass handbell frozen into the entry stones.
rooms.secrets: A hidden under-ice crawl beneath wind-packed snow leads toward Room 7.
rooms.exits: Snow trail to Room 2, hidden under-ice crawl to Room 7.

rooms.name: Exposed Frost Court
rooms.readAloud: A roofless courtyard lies open to the sky. Broken pillars poke through snowdrifts like ribs, and frost has sealed old devotional mosaics.
rooms.gmNotes: Crosswinds can erase tracks quickly. The mosaics hint that the reliquary preserved memories, not wealth.
rooms.treasure: A silver-blue mosaic tile showing a flame cupped in snow.
rooms.secrets: One pillar shadow points toward the safest edge of the cracked pool in Room 3.
rooms.exits: Snow trail to Room 1, unstable frozen causeway to Room 3.

rooms.name: Cracked Frostglass Pool
rooms.readAloud: A wide frozen pool covers the old reliquary floor. Something dark moves far below, distorted by white cracks and trapped bubbles.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the layout hub. Ice groans under sudden movement; slow travel is safe, but combat or heavy loads make the route hazardous.

inhabitants.name: Under-Ice Watchers
inhabitants.tactics: Tap from below, lure travelers onto weak ice, retreat into dark water
inhabitants.morale: Fall quiet if a true memory is spoken aloud
inhabitants.wants: Names, warmth, and release from the pool
inhabitants.leverage: Can be bargained with by offering a remembered story

rooms.treasure: A frostglass bead that glows when held near a forgotten name.
rooms.secrets: A bright crack shows that the sealed vault is still powered by a living winter flame.
rooms.exits: Unstable frozen causeway to Room 2, ice bridge to Room 4, broken ice bridge to Room 5, slick ledge to Room 6.

rooms.name: Buried Statue Alcove
rooms.readAloud: Three frost-coated statues lean together in a half-buried chapel nook. Their faces have been rubbed smooth by windblown ice.
rooms.gmNotes: The statues can answer one question if brushed clean with bare hands, but doing so numbs the character for a short while.

inhabitants.name: Reliquary Echoes
inhabitants.tactics: Question intruders, freeze lies into visible breath, call wind through cracks
inhabitants.morale: Stand down for respectful offerings or remembered names
inhabitants.leverage: Respond to bells, vows, and careful treatment of the dead

rooms.treasure: A carved ice-lens set into a statue palm.
rooms.secrets: The rightmost statue is not stone; it is a spirit wearing frost as a shell.

rooms.name: Broken Ice Bridge Crossing
rooms.readAloud: A narrow ice bridge spans a dark crevasse. Old stone railings jut from the ice, but most have snapped away into the blue-black gap.
rooms.gmNotes: The crossing is passable but hazardous. The bridge can be made safer by anchoring rope to exposed stone railings.

inhabitants.name: Rime-Wing Beasts
inhabitants.tactics: Swoop across the crevasse, force movement, perch where the bridge narrows
inhabitants.morale: Retreat if their nesting ice is cracked open
inhabitants.wants: Quiet nesting sites and warm prey
inhabitants.leverage: Can be driven off with reflected light or ringing bells

rooms.treasure: A bundle of old reliquary rope preserved under rime.
rooms.secrets: A faint glow below the crevasse marks the vault line.
rooms.exits: Broken ice bridge to Room 3, brittle bridge down to Room 8.

rooms.name: Collapsed Frost Chamber
rooms.readAloud: The ceiling has fallen into a mound of blue ice and broken stone. A sheltered passage curls behind the collapse, rimed with white needles.
rooms.gmNotes: This chamber gives the party a safer staging point before the vault. Searching the collapse reveals both the route to Room 7 and the stair to Room 8.

inhabitants.name: Icebound Bandits
inhabitants.tactics: Hide behind ice slabs, bargain before fighting, flee toward tunnels
inhabitants.morale: Surrender if promised warmth and a way out
inhabitants.wants: A relic worth carrying and safe passage home
inhabitants.leverage: Know which ice sings before it breaks

rooms.treasure: A pouch of blue-white salt crystals used to grip slick ice.
rooms.secrets: A shallow chisel mark shows someone recently opened the hidden crawl to Room 7.
rooms.exits: Slick ledge to Room 3, frozen tunnel to Room 7, ice stair to Room 8.

rooms.name: Hidden Under-Ice Passage
rooms.readAloud: A low tunnel runs between blue ice and buried masonry. Breath comes back as glittering frost, and old handholds vanish under refrozen sheets.
rooms.gmNotes: The passage is secret from the entry side and narrow enough to make retreat awkward. It lets careful players bypass the central pool.
rooms.treasure: A bone-handled ice awl wrapped in oilcloth.
rooms.secrets: The tunnel was cut by reliquary keepers as an emergency memory-vault escape route.
rooms.exits: Frozen tunnel to Room 6, hidden under-ice crawl to Room 1.

rooms.name: Glowing Sealed Vault
rooms.readAloud: A round vault door glows through layers of ice. Beyond it, a small blue flame burns without heat, lighting names carved into the walls.
rooms.gmNotes: The finale can be social, puzzle, or hazard-focused. Opening the vault safely requires a remembered name, the bell from Room 1, or the ice-lens from Room 4.

inhabitants.name: The Frostglass Keeper
inhabitants.tactics: Locks memories in ice, seals exits with frost, tests whether intruders remember the dead
inhabitants.morale: Yields if the reliquary purpose is honored
inhabitants.wants: To preserve names from being erased by time
inhabitants.leverage: Accepts vows, bells, and honest memories as proof of intent

rooms.treasure: The frostglass reliquary flame, a ledger of preserved names, and a crystal key that never warms.
rooms.secrets: The relic is not cursed; it has been freezing the ruin to keep a forgotten plague sealed below.
rooms.exits: Ice stair to Room 6, brittle bridge to Room 5.

gmNotes: Make safe routes feel cold and tense, but keep them visually distinct from cracks and crevasses.
This dungeon works best when memory, names, bells, and vows matter as much as fighting.
The hidden crawl gives cautious players a way around the most dangerous central ice.
The twist is that the reliquary is preserving a plague seal, not hoarding treasure.
